text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has repeatedly felt rewarding, but I should avoid taking profits by habit and weigh each holding’s prospects and portfolio balance.","I should not let the pain of admitting a loss keep me invested in a weak position; review the reasons for holding it and make a deliberate choice.","Short-term account swings do not prove a strategy is working or failing. I should check my portfolio periodically, stay patient, and trade only when my reasons change."]}
